system.description:
Spend an Interact Action and 1 Luck Point from your Luck Bank to let another ally take 1 additional Attack Action. Once per ally per Combat Encounter.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.75
system.summary: Spend an Interact Action and 1 Luck Point from your Luck Bank to let another ally take 1 additional Attack Action. Once per ally per Combat Encounter.

automation.note: The ally you choose may take 1 additional Attack Action. Each ally can get this only once per Combat Encounter.
